findings.evidenceJa: じゃはりきって先生がやっちゃおっかな
findings.governingReading: then perhaps teacher will energetically handle the duty herself
findings.explanation: Taiga’s playful enthusiasm at taking over the absent students’ duty disappears.
The classroom command contains an erroneous split in “everyone.”

findings.evidenceJa: 欠席者は昨日より増えていて
findings.governingReading: there are more absentees than yesterday
findings.explanation: The day-over-day increase in school absences disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえは飄々とホームルームを進めていく
findings.governingReading: Taiga conducts homeroom with her usual breezy nonchalance
findings.explanation: A characterizing manner becomes an unclear degree adverb.

findings.evidenceJa: このまま教室でカンヅメってなさい
findings.governingReading: stay cooped up in the classroom with the worksheet
findings.explanation: Taiga’s comic confinement instruction and the requirement to remain in class disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: ガタゴトと机を移動させていく
findings.governingReading: move their desks with a clattering racket
findings.explanation: The sound and disorder of the delighted class disappear.
Taiga’s conspicuously casual beckoning call is reduced to his name.
The culturally and thematically resonant intuition idiom becomes a generic hunch.

findings.highlight: you could get run over by a car or fall off a bridge
findings.evidenceJa: その後って決まって士郎が車に轢かれたり橋から落ちたりした
findings.governingReading: each time afterward Shirou invariably was hit by a car or fell from a bridge
findings.explanation: Repeated past accidents become hypothetical possibilities.

findings.highlight: you’re still at the platform and I’m waving goodbye to you
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎だけホームに残っちゃって、ばいばーいって手を振ってる
findings.governingReading: Shirou alone remains on the platform, waving goodbye
findings.explanation: mirror moon transfers the farewell wave from the abandoned Shirou to the departing Taiga, reversing the dream image.

findings.highlight: I woke up late because of that
findings.evidenceJa: お姉ちゃん、おかげで寝坊しちゃったんだよぅ
findings.governingReading: your big sister overslept because of it
findings.explanation: Taiga’s playful older-sister self-address and drawn-out complaint disappear.

findings.governingReading: oh, for goodness’ sake; he is exasperated
findings.explanation: Shirou’s relieved exasperation becomes stunned speechlessness.

findings.evidenceJa: 他には何もなかったんだな
findings.governingReading: nothing else had happened after all
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference that oversleeping exhausts the cause of concern disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 寝不足なの、夢の中だけじゃないんじゃないか
findings.governingReading: perhaps the lack of sleep is not confined to the dream
findings.explanation: The joke linking Taiga’s dream oversleeping to her real dark circles is replaced by generic advice.

findings.highlight: not doing too well in social studies, so you might fail
findings.evidenceJa: 現代社会の成績悪いんだから。気合いれないと赤点
findings.governingReading: his Modern Society grades are poor and he risks a failing mark
findings.explanation: The named course and risk of a failing score are generalized toward failing the subject outright.
mirror moon adds cheerfulness to Taiga’s deliberately light departure.

findings.evidenceJa: 張り合いがないというか、拍子抜けしたというか
findings.governingReading: it feels as though something to rise to is missing, or as though he has been caught by an anticlimax
findings.explanation: Two distinct shades of domestic deflation collapse into disappointment.
